answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 45771 Country: India Title: Halal or Haram Question: I am staying in Hyderabad in a rented house. We have only one electric meter for both owner and tenants. Owner arranged an electrician so that we will get a fixed electric bill, and he is paying half and I am paying other half. I, myself, told the owner at the time of rent agreement that I am ready to pay all the bill of the electricity which I use as I do not want to involve in this electricity theft but He was not ready. So What I have to do now? Answer ID: 45771 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1846/512/TH=12/1434) You should fix your separate meter and pay the bill accordingly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
